column1: # Khadas Edge1 - eMMC partition table for Android 14 on mainline U-Boot.
# This replaces the Rockchip pair parameter.txt + package-file, which described
# the same layout in the format afptool and Rockchip's maskrom loader read. Path B
# boots with mainline U-Boot, which uses an ordinary GPT, so the layout is
# expressed as one and build/build.sh turns it into an sgdisk script.
# The bootloader is NOT a partition here. Mainline U-Boot on RK3399 lives in raw
# sectors ahead of the first partition: idbloader.img at sector 64 and u-boot.itb
# at sector 16384, which is the layout this board already boots from for OpenWrt.
# The first partition therefore starts at 16MiB, leaving that area alone.
# Columns: name <TAB> size in MiB ("rest" = fill the device) <TAB> image file, or
# "-" for a partition that is created empty and formatted by Android.
# bootfs       a 512MiB FAT holding boot.scr plus the kernel, ramdisk and dtb as
#              files, all built by build/build-bootfs.sh from boot.img. It is FIRST on
#              purpose: the RK3399 BootROM prefers the eMMC to the SD card, so on a
#              board with anything bootable on its eMMC the card's own U-Boot never
#              runs - but the eMMC's U-Boot runs distro boot, which scans the SD card
#              first and, with no partition flagged bootable, looks in partition 1 for
#              boot.scr. The files are there, rather than read out of the boot
#              partition, because that U-Boot (Armbian's 2022.07) cannot do the sector
#              arithmetic: it has no setexpr. See boot.cmd next to this file.
#              512MiB rather than the 128 the boot files need: on a userdebug build
#              edge1-bootwatch streams the whole logcat and dmesg of every boot into
#              edge1-logs/ here, and a crash loop logs 50MB in ten minutes.
# misc         the bootloader control block: recovery and the boot reason live
#              here, and Android will write to it whether or not we flash it.
# vbmeta       AVB metadata. Present and flashed even though verification is not
#              enforced on a userdebug build, because init reads it.
# metadata     required by dynamic partitions: libsnapshot keeps the logical
#              partition metadata in it, and keys for metadata encryption.
# super        system, system_ext, product, vendor and odm as logical partitions.
#              Never flash those images individually - that bypasses the
#              dynamic-partition metadata and the device does not boot.
# vendor_boot is not here any more. BoardConfig.mk moved to boot image header v2,
# which puts the kernel, the ramdisk and the dtb in one boot.img - see the note
# there for why. boot and recovery are 96MiB to match
# BOARD_BOOTIMAGE_PARTITION_SIZE and BOARD_RECOVERYIMAGE_PARTITION_SIZE; the sizes
# here and there have to agree, or an image that the build accepted will not fit
# the partition it is written to.
bootfs
misc
boot
recovery
vbmeta
metadata
super
userdata
